sources.what: 8 sub-tables dk,d2,d1,k,h,d0,d3 (mapped to d2,d3,d4,e,h,k,m); same numbers as torqbolt
h,k,d2,d3,d4 (older table; differs at M6 only)
distributor's own technical datasheet (d2,d3,d4,h,e,k; M6..M56; marks M6,M14,M18,M22,M27,M33 as not in the standard)
manufacturer catalogue page 'Eye nuts, generally to DIN 582' (d2,d3,d4,e,h)

dropped.why: Birkhofer marks M6 as not in the standard; schrauben-lexikon (older edition) lists a different M6 row (d2 17, d3 27, d4 16, h 31, k 6) vs 9 other pages 20/36/20/36/8
intermediate sizes not in the standard (Birkhofer asterisk); sources conflict (e.g. M27: 65/108/60 vs 50/90/50 vs 55/96/60; M33: 75/126/70 vs 65/108/60)
e (base height) only in torqbolt and fullerfasteners (steelnutbolts.com is a copy of the fuller table) -> 2 independent sources
only ganternorm and fullerfasteners list it
rated loads, not dimensions; sources disagree (M6: 70/75/80/90 kg; M30: 3200 vs 3600 vs 2.1 t etc.) and edition-dependent -> not published

dropped.what: greenpin M48 row (d2 110, d3 184, ... = M52 values)

dropped.why: rows inconsistent with the standard (e.g. M12 ring 36/63/63), not used

checks: d3 > d2 >= d4 in all rows
k == (d3 - d4)/2 exactly in all 13 rows (ring cross-section relation)
h within 4 mm of d3 in all rows
e < k + 6 and e grows with size
every column non-decreasing with thread size
per-cell majority >=3 sources; outliers listed in evidence
shape_hint: A forged ring-shaped lifting eye nut: a short flat-bottomed cylindrical base (collar, diameter d2, height e) with an internal metric thread, from which a round closed ring (outer diameter d3, inner diameter d4, ring thickness k) rises vertically; total height h is about equal to the ring outer diameter.

role_map.d3: outside diameter of the eye ring
role_map.d4: inside (hole) diameter of the eye ring
role_map.h: overall height from seat to top of ring

notes: Nominal values only. Governing standard DIN 582 (steel, stainless and C15E forged eye nuts; edition year of the source tables not established (sources do not state it; the current 2024-05 edition was not checked)). Intermediate sizes (M14, M18, M22, M27, M33, M39, M45, M52, M60) are not standard sizes and were dropped. Sizes M72 and above have fine/coarse pitch 6 (M72x6); pitch column omitted because sources do not tabulate it consistently. Working-load limits (WLL) deliberately omitted: they are ratings, sources disagree for some sizes, and the user must take them from the manufacturer's current datasheet. KS B 1034 not verified. row_support = lowest per-column agreement (columns k/d2/d3/d4/h: M72 has 3-4, M64 4-6, M8-M56 >=4; e is the weakest column).

verification.checks_done: Live curl (HTTP 200) of ganternorm, torqbolt, fullerfasteners, h-lift, lgrigging, seilerei-voigt, drahtseile24, schrauben-lexikon (globalfastener d241 returned 403 live - not counted; steelnutbolts fetched, copy of fuller). 13 rows x 6 columns (d2,d3,d4,e,h,k) x 8 page instances (torqbolt and fuller compared separately but merged): every record cell equals every page value that exists (0 mismatches). Cluster counts per cell with TF merged and PDFs excluded: rows M8-M36: d2/d3/d4/k 6-7, h 5-6, e exactly 3 (ganternorm, TF, lgrigging); rows M42-M64: d2/d3/d4/k 4, h 3, e 2 (TF, lgrigging); M72: d2/d3/d4/h/k 2 (TF, voigt), e 1. Sanity: k=(d3-d4)/2 exact for all 13 rows, d3>d2>=d4, h within 4 mm of d3, monotone.
problems: e column fails for M42, M48, M56, M64, M72: after merging torqbolt+fuller (identical numbers) only torqbolt/fuller and lgrigging list e above M36 (ganternorm stops at M36); the producer's count of 4-5 came from the two vendor PDFs (Birkhofer datasheet, Greenpin catalogue), which may not count. Rows dropped rather than the column; alternative is to keep M42-M64 and drop column e.
M72 additionally has only torqbolt/fuller and seilerei-voigt for d2,d3,d4,h,k (2 clusters) -> fails regardless.

Thin cells: e for M8..M36 has exactly 3 clusters (ganternorm, torqbolt/fuller, lgrigging). lgrigging M8 e is typed '8,5' (decimal comma in an otherwise dot table), a hint that its e column may have been pasted from a German-notation table (ganternorm/Birkhofer); if lgrigging were ruled dependent on ganternorm, e would drop to 2 clusters and the whole column would have to be dropped.

h-lift and lgrigging share identical off-standard values for non-standard sizes (M22 45/81, M27 50/90/50/20, M33 65/108, M39 75/126, M45 85/144, M52 100/166) that differ from torqbolt/birkhofer, so they may be one lineage; the kept sizes M8-M64 d2,d3,d4,k still have >=3 clusters with H+L merged (TF, H+L, V) and ganternorm for <=M36.

Fullerfasteners uses symbols dk,d2,d1,k,h,d0,d3 for the record's d2,d3,d4,e,h,k,m (mapped by value-matching, not by DIN 582 symbol names); harmless here because it is merged with torqbolt whose headers are d1,d2,d3,d4,e,h,k explicitly.

Edition: DIN 582 edition year of the tables is not stated by any source (current 2024-05 edition not checked); intermediate sizes M14,M18,M22,M27,M33,M39,M45,M52,M60 are non-standard and correctly excluded; M6 correctly excluded (older edition differs). Values are nominal only.

standard_full: DIN 582 (lifting eye nuts, coarse thread; nominal dimensions)
